verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Notion has databases with properties that can be created and updated, including via API, webhooks and MCP. Community users describe it as incredibly flexible and configurable, using it as a project and issue tracker that sits between strict JIRA-style PM tools and unstructured wikis. That implies custom fields fit a team's process, but nothing explicitly documents configuring workflow statuses or custom property types, and one user notes they quickly hit limits for project and issue tracking. Missing for 10: first-party docs on custom property and field types, explicit documentation of customizable workflow and status options, hands-on corroboration of status-workflow setup.
